item.title: 1978 Volkswagen Type 2 Westfalia
item.description: This 1978 Volkswagen Type 2 Westfalia is finished in Sage Green over plaid green cloth and is powered by an air-cooled 1,970cc flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. Features include a pop-up roof tent with a bed platform as well as Bosch fuel injection, front disc brakes, 14" steel wheels, a shore power connection port, jalousie windows, white bumpers, a folding rear bench/bed, a stowable table, privacy curtains, storage cabinets, and a kitchenette with a refrigerator and a sink.

item.title: 2010 Ford F-450 Super Duty King Ranch Crew Cab Power Stroke Dually 4×4 FX4
item.description: This 2010 Ford F-450 Super Duty King Ranch has 51k miles following a registration history in California. It was specified in White Platinum Tri-Coat over Chaparral leather, and it was optioned with the FX4 Off-Road Package. Power is provided by a 6.4-liter Power Stroke Turbodiesel V8 linked with a five-speed TorqShift automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a limited-slip rear differential. item.title: 2008 Audi A8L at No Reserve
item.description: This 2008 Audi A8L remained in Colorado with its first two owners before the third owner relocated it to Indiana, and it was then purchased in 2025 by the seller, who moved it to Wisconsin. The car is finished in Night Blue Pearl Effect over Amaretto Valcona leather and is powered by a 4.2-liter V8 linked with a six-speed Tiptronic automatic transaxle and a Quattro all-wheel-drive system. item.description: This 2013 Maserati GranTurismo MC is powered by a 4.7-liter F136 V8 paired with a six-speed automatic gearbox and has been fitted with a Larini Systems X-pipe. It is finished in Grigio Granito over Nero leather and features MC-specific bodywork, carbon-fiber trim, and 20″ MC-Design wheels along with navigation, a Bose sound system, and heated power-adjustable front seats. item.title: 1974 DeTomaso Pantera
item.description: This 1974 DeTomaso Pantera was specified from the factory as one of 68 examples finished in Medium Green. It was sold new through Peterson & Son Lincoln-Mercury of Lapeer, Michigan, in September 1974, and remained under the care of its original owner until 2006. The car subsequently underwent mechanical work by Roush Industries in Michigan and Performance Automotive Technologies (P.A.T.) in Massachusetts before being repainted in 2008. item.title: 19k-Mile 1995 BMW M3 Lightweight Track Car
item.description: This 1995 BMW M3 Lightweight was first sold in California, and in 2012 with 16k miles on the odometer it was converted into a NASA GTS-class race car. item.description: This 1986 Buick Grand National was delivered new to Schepel Buick, Inc. of Merrillville, Indiana, and was previously listed on BaT in July 2021 and a sold on BaT in May 2023 before it was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025. Power comes from a turbocharged and intercooled 3.8-liter V6 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission, and the car is finished in black over two-tone black and Sand Gray cloth upholstery.
